svg.desc: Corpus snapshot with 142 papers, 3 missing years excluded. Publication groups follow recorded venue coding. 2023: 4 peer-reviewed, 0 preprints, total 4; 2024: 6 peer-reviewed, 10 preprints, total 16; 2025: 11 peer-reviewed, 32 preprints, total 43; 2026: 8 peer-reviewed, 68 preprints, total 76
